answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a basalt-hard stake: a refundable deposit locked per agent, slashed on provable misbehavior. Work history then forms a thread linking each identity past transactions and attestations, so reputation accumulates slowly and cannot be bought in bulk. A regular heartbeat pulse, a signed proof of continuous useful work, keeps identities alive; dormant or mass-created accounts decay and lose weight. Creating thousands of fake agents becomes expensive and slow, while honest agents earn standing cheaply.
